w496301638.name: CTT Student Hall
w496301638.why: OSM draws two thin arms west of the roof terrace. The walk video (IMG_7723, 0-25 s) shows they are the ramps down to the lawn, not storeys. Trimmed so the jump off the terrace edge lands on open ground instead of a 3.4 m slot between two walls (decided 2026-11-08). The ramps can come back as low props outside the landing zone.
